paper.construction: original finite weighted-access reflection; no correction time-integral circuit

cases.name: diagonal

resource_ledger.classical_preprocessing: explicit Gaussian/prefix masses and naive Gray-Walsh angle transform: O(M^2) time, O(M) storage; wall time is not quantum runtime
resource_ledger.input_access: explicit real Pauli list and normalized Pauli proposals; Gaussian loading, signed product-formula evolution and Pauli SELECT included in both access streams
resource_ledger.initialization: unknown system input and every auxiliary zero are caller supplied; preparation/reset gates and time are excluded
resource_ledger.readout: no measurement, discard/reset, repetition or amplification is emitted by this block oracle
exclusions: external input preparation and zero-auxiliary initialization/reset
general coherent correction and its evolution

metadata.pauli_label_order: character i acts on qi; q0 is least significant
metadata.decay_definition: D_fin=eta*sum_(a,l) gamma_l*B_(a,l)^dagger*B_(a,l), with actual finite-Trotter access blocks
metadata.selected_block: D_fin/alpha with every auxiliary compressed to zero; alpha=eta*gamma_max
metadata.selection_probability: norm(D_fin*psi)^2/alpha^2 for normalized caller input psi; input dependent
metadata.phase_convention: P(pi) supplies the branch minus sign; both complete access/weight inverses are unconditional, preserving source phases

cases.logical_resource_scope: one complete unitary oracle, including both realized access copies and inverses; caller supplies system input and zero auxiliaries; no readout or amplification

normalization.scope: eta=dt*sum(f_j**2) independently; eta does not disappear from physical alpha
